Most advice on this topic is vague. This guide is a field note: what to change on your site this week so you stand out for the right reasons.

The default path (Drive folders, Canva PDFs, unfinished Notion pages) makes you look busy — not hire-ready.

This guide is for builders polishing the details that change first impressions who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

undefined

Do this next

  1. Delete anything you can’t defend in an interview
  2. Test on a phone before you share
  3. Ask one mentor for a 60-second reaction

What to leave out

Skip private addresses, ID numbers, half-finished clones of famous products, and anything you can’t discuss without cringing. Scarcity of content is better than noise.

How a website helps you stand out

Small craft decisions — photo quality, copy length, load speed — compound into “this person seems sharp.”

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Delete anything you can’t defend in an interview
  • Test on a phone before you share
  • Ask one mentor for a 60-second reaction

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
